note: The MQTT parser derives its cursor p directly from the input-controlled buffer bytes.
The input-controlled remaining length n determines the end pointer for the MQTT packet body.
The zero topic length in the candidate advances p to the MQTT5 properties-length field inside the packet.
The guard admits a properties length field with only three remaining bytes, but decode_variable_length may read four bytes and requires a terminating byte or enough remaining bytes.
The unchecked cursor p is passed to the variable-length decoder without the remaining byte count.
The decoder is allowed to advance offset through four bytes based only on the MQTT varint maximum, not on the input buffer end.
For candidate bytes 0x80 0x80 0x80 at the end of the packet, offset reaches 3 and p[offset] reads one byte past the heap buffer.
